verdict.rationale: The docs overview says Meilisearch exposes stored documents and embeddings through semantic search and conversational interfaces from a single API. Hybrid/semantic retrieval with automatic embedding generation is documented. Product pages position it as a RAG retrieval layer and as conversational search that gives grounded answers from your own content. Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs for the conversational/answer endpoint (request and response, LLM configuration, streaming), RAG integration guides, and independent hands-on corroboration of the conversational feature.
